name: hud_ui_cycle_selector_widget_load_from_zrd
description: HudUiCycleSelectorWidget::LoadFromZrd delegates base ZRD loading, reads FONT and TEXTOFFSET, loads CYCLE entries, creates text entries with font styles, creates bitmap entries, clamps item count to 20, and returns success.
known_limits: Binary Ninja marks the reconstruction limited because the CYCLE loop uses a byte-offset stack slot that HLIL keeps rendering as the owner parameter after a failed split; source uses typed zReader node iteration and leaves tier S verification to the HudUiCycleSelectorWidget source-cluster pass.

Bitmap image loading is accepted through HudUiCycleSelectorWidget::AddBitmapEntry and HudUiWidget::SetImageByPathOwned dependency coverage; this focused smoke uses a null image path to avoid opening retail texture archives.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4b82e0 validates the HudUiZrdWidget::LoadFromZrd call, optional FONT and TEXTOFFSET reads, CYCLE count clamp, visibleCount growth, per-entry TEXT lookup with zLoc resolution and ApplyFontStyleForEntry, per-entry BITMAP lookup with origin-adjusted coordinates, and success return.

Native smoke zhud_cycle_selector_widget_load_from_zrd_smoke verifies owner propagation, FONT and TEXTOFFSET state, two-entry CYCLE count/visible-count growth, text entry creation with text offset and font style applied, bitmap entry creation with origin-relative coordinates, hidden bitmap visibility, and success return.
